name: orthomcl-one-protein-in-each-cryptosporidium-genome
turns: Which ortholog groups have exactly one protein in each Cryptosporidium genome?
rationale: A genus that is no clade code in the taxonomy is the list of its genome codes; single copy over that list is the list's taxon count equal to its length and its protein count equal to the same number.

provenance.curatorNote: Single copy within a genus written as a list of genome codes.
